verdict.rationale: Digits claims real-time integrations with 12,000+ financial institutions and live connected financial data. It describes financial activity collected continuously and dashboards that update automatically as transactions sync, and its help center covers adding a new connection. That clearly covers automatic import from connected financial accounts. Missing for 10: explicit mention of credit-card account connections (only Ramp is named), documented connection setup steps and sync-frequency details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
